routes.trustResourceLoading: Starts a fresh Pi process with project context, extensions, prompts, themes, and discovered skills disabled. It explicitly loads only the installed Jig and create-verification-skill procedures.
routes.pauseResumeBehavior: Exit at awaiting-principles when the operator has not supplied a complete response. Resume active work with jig init.
routes.routeMismatchRecovery: Resume with /skill:jig init or /jig init when the manifest records inherited-session.

routes.trustResourceLoading: Uses the current trusted Pi session and its installed pstack skills. It never starts a nested Pi process.
routes.pauseResumeBehavior: Stop at awaiting-principles when the operator has not supplied a complete response. Resume active work with /skill:jig init.
routes.routeMismatchRecovery: Resume with jig init when the manifest records isolated-shell.

routes.trustResourceLoading: Expands to the registered Jig skill in the current trusted Pi session. It never starts a nested Pi process.
routes.pauseResumeBehavior: Stop at awaiting-principles when the operator has not supplied a complete response. Resume active work with /jig init.
routes.routeMismatchRecovery: Resume with jig init when the manifest records isolated-shell.
